title: Wrong Votes, Right Gradients: Why Majority-Vote Rewards Track Verifiable RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.20898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with self-generated labels, such as majority vote over a model's own samples, often recovers most of the gain of training with verifiable rewards. This is puzzling from the usual prompt-level view, in which majority vote only returns a model's modal answer and cannot add information about correctness. We argue that the relevant unit is the batch-level update. Because parameters are shared, a prompt's own gradient accounts for less than 1\% of the change in that prompt's output at practical batch sizes, so a wrong label matters only to the extent that label errors share a direction across prompts. We decompose the majority-vote update into shrinkage and misdirection relative to the gold update, and show that misdirection vanishes with batch size whenever errors are incoherent across prompts, however often the labels are wrong. translated_title: 错误的投票，正确的梯度：为什么多数投票奖励能媲美可验证奖励强化学习
translated_abstract: 使用自生成标签的强化学习（例如对模型自身的采样结果进行多数投票）往往能获得与可验证奖励训练相当的大部分收益。从通常的提示层面视角来看，这一现象令人费解：多数投票只是返回模型的众数答案，无法增加关于正确性的信息。我们认为，正确的分析单元应是批次级别的更新。由于参数是共享的，在实际批次规模下，某个提示自身的梯度对该提示输出变化的贡献不足1%，因此错误标签只有在不同提示之间的标签误差共享相同方向时才会产生影响。我们将多数投票更新相对于金标准更新分解为收缩与误导两个分量，并证明：只要误差在不同提示之间不相干，无论标签出错的频率有多高，误导分量都会随批次规模增大而消失。通过在五个模型上测量每个响应的梯度，我们发现多数投票误差是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将分析单位从提示层面转向批次级参数更新，证明多数投票等自监督奖励之所以能媲美可验证奖励强化学习，是因为当标签误差在不同提示之间不相干时，其对参数更新的误导作用会随批次规模增大而消失。
en_tdlr: Shifting the analysis from prompt-level labels to batch-level parameter updates, this paper shows that majority-vote rewards rival verifiable RL because label errors that are incoherent across prompts produce misdirection that vanishes with batch size.
